description: This file contains the implementation of the PDO MySQL driver class 'ADODB_pdo_mysql' for the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It defines SQL syntax, database-specific methods, and configuration for MySQL interactions via PDO.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_mysql
classes.description: The PDO MySQL driver class extending ADODB_pdo, providing methods for MySQL-specific SQL syntax and database interactions.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, setting transaction and insert ID options.

methods.name: OffsetDate
methods.description: Calculates a date offset by a fractional number of days.

methods.name: metaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a specified table from MySQL.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Returns a CONCAT SQL expression for given arguments.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves table metadata, possibly filtered by schema or name pattern.

methods.name: SetAutoCommit
methods.description: Configures the autocommit mode for the PDO connection.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Obtains column metadata for a specific table.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates a date formatting SQL expression based on a format string.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new sequence ID, creating the sequence table if necessary.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence table and initializes it with the start ID.
